name: Artful Dodge
benefit: If you are the only character threatening an opponent, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC against that opponent.
special:
The Artful Dodge feat acts as the Dodge feat for the purpose of satisfying prerequisites that require Dodge. You can use Intelligence, rather than Dexterity, for feats with a minimum Dexterity prerequisite.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Armor Master's Handbook pg. 20
You can spend 5 stamina points to gain a +1 dodge bonus for each opponent that you threaten that no other ally threatens. (Melee Tactics Toolbox 7)
flavor: You are practiced at avoiding attacks when outnumbered.
